title: Easy Netherite
description: Original Published 2019 - You can smelt any Netherite tool in a furnace to obtain a Netherite Ingot, giving you a new way to recycle your gear.
body:
**This data pack was made so you can smelt coal and easily get Netherite**

This should be very useful for survival players since Netherite are one of the most useful resources in the game.


###  How to Download and Install Easy Netherite Data Pack:
### 
1. Download the datapack file from Planet Minecraft
2. Drop the **"Easy Netherite"** file into your minecraft world's datapack file
3. Do /reload in your world
   ```
   /reload
   ```
4. Enjoy mod :)

## **Update Note:**

### **Old system:**
- Smelting always gave a Netherite Ingot

### **New system**:
- Removed coal-based recipes:
    ✖ Coal Block → Netherite Block
    ✖ Coal → Netherite Ingot
- Smelting now gives random rewards with balanced drop rates

## **Versions:**

**Easy Netherite v3.0** – uses the new system (no coal recipes, random rewards)

**Easy Netherite v3.0 Retro** – restores the classic system:
    - Coal Block → Netherite Block
    - Coal → Netherite Ingot
    - (no drop rates)
